messages:
maya: Quick ask — can someone run a short throughput probe against cb-config v2 on staging? Need: 10s warmup, 60s run, varying max_batch_size {8,16}, max_tokens {512,1024}, and queue_window_ms {5,20}. Target ~250 rps steady. Flag me with p95/p99 latency and tokens/sec.

sam: I can kick off a set now. Which model variant? default-7b-8k or 7b-q4?

maya: start with default-7b-8k, then q4 if we have time. Use cb build `cb/2024-11-06`.

ravi: looping in @jess — she has the loadgen orchestration and upload hooks.

jess: got it. I'll run the matrix on the staging pool and upload artifacts. Example command I'll use:

```
./run_loadgen --model default-7b-8k --warmup 10 --duration 60 --rps 250 --max-batch 16 --max-tokens 512 --queue-window-ms 20 --out /tmp/cb-runs/1729991111/results.json
```

jess: I'll run each combo (batch 8/16 x tokens 512/1024 x qwin 5/10/20) and put manifests at /tmp/cb-runs/1729991111/

ops-bot: deploy finished for cb/2024-11-06 to staging at 1729991100 :white_check_mark:

sam: starting runs now — first: max-batch=8 max-tokens=512 qwindow=5

sam: quick note — small spike at iter 3 (p99 -> 430ms). one-line log: `p99=430ms p95=120ms tokens/s=45`

maya: thanks — keep them coming. For the q4 run please also record nvtop/GPU util and any memory spikes.

jess: uploaded raw results + run manifest: https://storage.internal/redwood/cb-runs/1729991111/results-manifest.json

ravi: quick parse w/ jq: `jq '.runs[] | {cfg, p95, p99, tokens_per_sec}' results-manifest.json` — first pass: batch=16, tokens=1024, qwin=20 gives highest tokens/sec but p99 rises notably.

sam: short summary here: 
- batch=8 / tokens=512 / qwin=5 -> p95 110ms, p99 380ms, tokens/s 42
- batch=16 / tokens=1024 / qwin=20 -> p95 190ms, p99 620ms, tokens/s 78
- q4 quant reduced p99 by ~15% but increased variance slightly

maya: great. Action items: (1) try queue_window=10ms for the 16/1024 case; (2) run a 5-minute soak on the candidate config; (3) if soak OK, open PR to update default cb caps. I'll file the PR after soak.

jess: starting 5-min soak on batch=16 tokens=1024 qwindow=10ms — run id `cb-1729991111-soak-1`

ops-bot: soak run cb-1729991111-soak-1 started at 1729991300

sam: during soak saw occasional router GC log at 1729991360 — pinging eng-sre now

ravi: quick heap dump uploaded: s3://internal/dumps/heap-1729991360.bin (for SRE triage)

maya: if soak completes clean, we'll opt-in experiment as default for staging and run a longer nightly. Thanks all :tada:

jess: soak finished clean — p95 steady ~200ms, p99 ~410ms, tokens/s 75. no OOMs, no GPU throttles. closing loop and uploading final manifest.

sam: acked, will add a small regression test for p99 > 700ms as a blocker.

maya: perfect. I'll follow up with the PR and changelog note. Appreciate the quick turn on this.
